---
title: "Assign VMR Values to GlobalGBWater Grid"
---

# Objective
+ Overlay the VMR gridded data onto the CropGBWater gridded data. Assign the VMR values to the corresponding grid cells in the GlobalGBWater raster.
+ The final output should should be grid_code level data and it should contain grid_code and VMR value.


# Data
+ The "*global_vmr_p.csv*" is the gridded data are at the 1.5 degree resolution, with an extent from 79.5 N to 57 S, and from 180 W to 178.5 E.
  + It is the VMR precipitation sink ratio: the share of precipitation at each receiving location that comes from upwind vegetation-regulated evaporation. 

+ Meanwhile, the CropGBWater gridded data is  5 arc-minute (1/12 degree) grids.

+ If the grids are perfectly aligned, one VMR cell contains 18*18 = 324 CropGBWater cells.


# Data Preparation
```{r}

# Set the directory containing the raw data files
raw_data_dir <- 
  "/Volumes/baseHD/NatCapTEEMs/GEP/WaterUse_Ag/Data/Raw"


# === Load VMR matrix === #
# the 1.5 degree resolution, with an extent from 79.5 N to 57 S, and from 180 W to 178.5 E
vmr_mat <- 
  fread(
    file.path(
      raw_data_dir, 
      "global_evap_recycling/global_vmr_p.csv"
    )
  )

# === Prepare CropGBWater Grid Code Lookup === #
# I need to know all combinations of (grid_code, X_CORD, Y_CORD)
ls_crops <- 
  fread(
    here("Data/Processed/CropGBWater_FAO_Ky_Kc.csv")
  )$CropGBWater_crop

grid_code_lookup <- 
  lapply(
    ls_crops,
    \(x){
        fread(
          here(
            paste0("Data/Processed/CropGBWater/wc/", x, "_grid_avg.csv")
          )
        )[
          , .(grid_code, X_CORD, Y_CORD)
        ]
    }
  ) %>%
  rbindlist() %>%
  unique()
```




```{r}
# /*===========================================*/
#'=  Construct georeferenced 1.5-degree VMR raster =
# /*===========================================*/
# VMR grid-cell centers:
# longitude: -180, -178.5, ..., 178.5
# latitude:    79.5, 78.0, ..., -57.0
#
# Therefore raster boundaries are half a cell (0.75 degrees) beyond the outer cell centers.

vmr_rast <-
  rast(
    nrows = 92,
    ncols = 240,
    xmin = -180.75,
    xmax =  179.25,
    ymin =  -57.75,
    ymax =   80.25,
    crs = "EPSG:4326"
  )

# terra stores cells row-by-row from upper-left.
# global_vmr_p.csv is also arranged north-to-south by rows,
# so transpose before vectorizing because R normally vectorizes
# matrices column-by-column.
values(vmr_rast) <- as.vector(t(vmr_mat))

names(vmr_rast) <- "vmr_p_pct"


# /*===========================================*/
#'=  Convert CropGBWater grid centers to spatial points =
# /*===========================================*/
crop_points <- 
  vect(
    grid_code_lookup,
    geom = c("X_CORD", "Y_CORD"),
    crs = "EPSG:4326",
    keepgeom = TRUE
  )


# /*===========================================*/
#'=  Extract VMR value for each CropGBWater grid cell =
# /*===========================================*/
vmr_extract <- 
  terra::extract(
    vmr_rast,
    crop_points
  )

grid_code_vmr <-
  copy(grid_code_lookup)[
    , vmr_p_pct := vmr_extract$vmr_p_pct
  ][
    , vmr_p := vmr_p_pct/100
  ]


# /*===== Check =====*/
grid_code_vmr[]

grid_code_vmr[
  ,
  .(
    n_grid = .N,
    n_vmr = sum(!is.na(vmr_p)),
    n_missing_vmr = sum(is.na(vmr_p)),
    share_missing_vmr = mean(is.na(vmr_p)),
    min_vmr = min(vmr_p, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_vmr = max(vmr_p, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
]
```



```{r}
# === Save === #
fwrite(
  grid_code_vmr,
  here("Data/Processed/CropGBWater_grid_code_vmr.csv")
)

```
